criteria.name: reader_precision
criteria.description: Is the reader avatar specific enough to generate a clear 'this is for me' reaction?

criteria.name: promise_specificity
criteria.description: Is the core promise bold, concrete, and believable — not vague or generic?

criteria.name: thesis_strength
criteria.description: Is the central argument sharp and defensible in one sentence?

criteria.name: market_distinctiveness
criteria.description: Does the brief define a genuinely different angle from comparable books?

criteria.name: scope_clarity
criteria.description: Are scope_in and scope_out defined clearly enough to prevent scope creep?

criteria.name: tone_precision
criteria.description: Are tone rules specific enough to be actionable by a writer?

criteria.name: evidence_awareness
criteria.description: Are sensitive claim areas identified so they can be handled carefully?
